review_conclusion: The frozen probe reproduces every saved V9 output bit. Frequency/angle match the current reference; rotation and finite casts match conditional on Device trig. The first difference is within SinCosFp32. Current NumPy FP32 trig itself differs from high-precision rounded trig, so greater mathematical accuracy alone is not an acceptance proof.
hypothesis: Differences between unchanged V9 Device SinCos and a separately rounded FP32 source replay arise after range reduction, in polynomial evaluation, sqrt or double-angle reconstruction. Isolating the earliest arithmetic divergence will distinguish a hardware-semantic issue from approximation error and avoid repeating failed cosine substitutions.
